text:
Ravi: legal asked if exports can be resumed if a download fails mid-bundle. They want an official resume token instead of re-downloading full history.
Lina: we can add a checkpoint token into each NDJSON page manifest. e.g. page_token that encodes last_commit_ts + page_index.
Tom: don't leak raw node ids in tokens. Make them opaque signed tokens (HMAC + base64).
Sophie: also need to handle tombstones. If resume skips over deletes we could mislead auditors. Each page should include tombstone markers and a `page_end_commit` watermark.
ops-bot: note: infra retention for checkpoints is 90 days (infra runbook: /infra/checkpoints.md).
Ravi: UX: download modal should show a "Resume previous export" option and show its expiry. If user clicks resume we return the next page stream.
Lina: API sketch: GET /v1/audit/export?start_token=<token>&limit=1000&include_tombstones=true. If start_token omitted we stream from live tail.
Tom: edge-case: tenant renames and event dedup. We must ensure event_id is stable across renames or provide a canonical id. Add `prev_entity` field for move events.
Sophie: verification: include a small manifest file at bundle root: {"pages": [ {"token": "t1", "hmac": "..."}, ...], "bundle_hmac": "..." } so they can verify integrity offline.
Ravi: sounds good. Also add a human-friendly resume id for the console so legal can hand it to SRE if they need us to help resume. That id maps to the opaque token server-side.
Lina: quotas: resuming historical scans must count against a separate historical_scan quota so attackers can't abuse resumes to scan old records.
Tom: security: bind tokens to tenant_id + requestor_id + expiry. Reject if token user != caller. Short TTL (5m) for one-click console resume, longer for presigned downloads.
Jen: infra note: can sign tokens with KMS HMAC and cache verification keys in the exporter. Workload impact minimal.
ops-bot: perf note: validating resume tokens adds ~40ms median to export startup, p95 ~480ms during bursts.
Sophie: console UX: on resume failure show clear error: "Resume expired or unauthorized. Start a fresh export." Provide link to audit-support.
Ravi: telemetry items: export.resume.request, export.resume.success, export.page.tombstone_count, export.manifest.verify_time_ms. Add alert if resume.success rate < 98% over 1h.
Lina: implementation plan: I'll own API + manifest schema. Tom will own token signing/validation. Jen will wire KMS HMAC and infra retention. Ravi will update console flows. Sophie will draft support copy.
Tom: I'll open a spike PR tomorrow with token library and sample validation route.
Ravi: timeline: internal canary by end of week. If we hit perf or quota surprises we fallback to no-resume downloads.
Sophie: +1. small follow-up: include `resume_point_reason` in manifest (snapshot|manual|retry) so consumers know why token was created.
Lina: ack. I'll add it to the schema.
Ravi: thanks all — I'll drop a short RFC in #docs and ping legal. :thumbsup:
Sophie: :+1:
ops-bot: reminder: create a Deck for infra handoff before canary deploy.
